name: Name
title: SSH
intro: Let your chats and agents run commands on a remote machine over SSH. By default you confirm each command and see the host and the exact text first.
limits: A command can change or delete anything the login user may touch. Use a dedicated user with only the rights the task needs. In the mode "Runs at once" no one confirms a command before it runs. The add-on opens one command at a time, with no terminal and no input.
hostHelp: The name or address of the machine, with a port if it is not 22: server.example.com or 10.0.0.5:2222. One connection is one host. Any other host is refused.
hostShape: This is not a host. Write a name or an address, with an optional port.
userHelp: The user the commands run as. A dedicated user lets you remove its access later without touching your own.
userShape: A user name has letters, digits and . _ - only.

login.label: Log in with
login.hint: The secret is kept sealed and never shown again.

passwdHelp: The password of that user. It is saved together with the user name as user:password.
keyHelp: Paste a key made only for LocalAI, in PEM or OpenSSH format, without a passphrase. Add its public half to authorized_keys on the host.
secretAgain: You changed the user or the host. Type the secret again.
keyShape: This is not a private key. It starts with -----BEGIN.
keyPassphrase: A key with a passphrase is not supported. Use a key without one.
credControl: The password has no control characters.

hostKey.label: Host key
hostKey.hint: The first time, the add-on reads the key the host presents. Compare its fingerprint with the one the machine shows, then trust it. Later, a different key is refused.
hostKey.trust: I compared this fingerprint and trust this host.
hostKey.needed: Check the host key before you save.
hostKey.unreachable: The host could not be reached.
hostKey.failed: The host key could not be read.

checkSeveral: The check runs when you have one SSH connection, because a check from this page cannot tell which one you mean. In a chat, enable the connections in the Tools menu.
noHost: No host: this connection reaches nothing.

confirmDelete.title: Delete {{name}}?
confirmDelete.message: Your chats can no longer reach this host, and the secret saved with it is deleted. To set it up again you must enter it again.

check.title: Check of {{name}}
check.refused: The host refused the login. Check the user, the password or the key.
check.changed: The host key changed. Nothing was sent. Edit the connection to check and trust the new key.
check.nopin: No host key is pinned. Edit the connection and check the host key.
check.unreachable: The host could not be reached. Check the host and the port.
check.busy: Another command is still running on this connection.
check.failed: The check did not finish. Try again in a moment.

setup.title: How to set it up
setup.step1: Make a user on the host just for LocalAI, with only the rights the task needs.
setup.step2: Make a key pair for it, or choose a password. Add the public key to the authorized_keys of that user.
setup.step3: Write the host and the user here, press Check host key and compare the fingerprint.
setup.step4: Leave the mode on Asks you first until you have read the limits on this page.
setup.fingerprint: The fingerprint of the host shows with: ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub

writeMode.label: What the agent may do on this host
writeMode.hint: Checking the connection is always allowed. Running a command needs a mode other than Off.

line.propose: Each command waits for your OK.

note.off: Commands are off: this connection only checks the login.
note.propose: Each command waits in your approvals with the host and the exact text until you confirm it.
note.auto: Commands run at once with no confirmation. Choose this only for a host and a user where a wrong command does no harm.

approval.title: Run a command on {{host}}
approval.physical: This runs on a real machine as soon as you confirm.
approval.asFirst: The first connection that lists this host
approval.asUnknown: An SSH connection for this host
approval.effect: The exact command above runs once, with no terminal and no input. Its output goes back to the chat.
